about: Skills the tool adds where PoB's gem dump (data/pob-*/gems.json) has none, in that dump's form, with their sources (COV35, 15 Nov 2026). GameData.gems appends each entry whose name PoB doesn't list. The bridge adds the same skill or gem to PoB itself (engine/bridge.lua: Untether's block; Empowered Sparks II's, GEM28): this file is the Python side's copy, so lookups by name or skill id (Context.all_gems / any_gems / gems_by_skill_id, gem_of) find it.

gems.description: Plant a seed of Abyssal Energy on the enemy's heart. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes their heart to explode, dealing Physical damage in an area.
gems.name: Untether
sources: game files build 26476662: ActiveSkills 826 abyssal_living_bomb 'Untether' (description, types); SkillGems -> BaseItemType Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAbyssalLivingBomb (Intelligence 100%)
engine/bridge.lua: the same skill (data.skills.AbyssalLivingBomb) and gem row, COV34 (bbc4da06)

League-obtainable through The Master's Reach (drops from the Vessel of Kulemak, 0.5.4; COV34), the one carrier found (checked: game Mods rows naming LivingBomb: UniqueAbyssalLivingBomb1 only; ModGrantedSkills: none; poe2db's Fists of Stone version is the same gloves under Way of the Stonefist). fromItem with tier 0, so Context.gems never offers it as a socketable gem

gems.description: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

sources: game files build 26650308: BaseItemTypes 5034 Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEmpoweredSparksTwo 'Empowered Sparks II'; SkillGems 1101 (CraftingTypes [11] as I's, CraftingLevel 4, Intelligence 100%); GemEffects 1103 EmpoweredSparksSupportTwo: I's support effect (GrantedEffects 1138) and Empower skill (512), its own Spark 514 TriggeredEmpoweredSparkPlayerTwo (2 more projectiles at every level, the same damage)
